title: Minecord Bridge
description: Full two-way chat bridge between Minecraft and Discord.
body:
# MineCord

## What it does
- Full two-way chat bridge between Minecraft and Discord.
- Auto-reconnect on launch and on disconnect (optional).
- Directional mute toggles (Minecraft → Discord / Discord → Minecraft).
- Hot-swap guilds and channels without redoing setup.
- Attachment previews with clickable file links.
- Direct messages in both directions.
- DM quick-reply and @mention highlights for your Minecraft name.
- Per-guild/channel prefixes with custom labels.

## Quick start
1) Launch Minecraft with the mod.
2) Run `/bridge setup`, then paste your Discord user token when prompted (or use `/bridge token set <token>`).
3) Click a server ID, then a channel ID (or type them).
4) Use `/bridge say <message>` to send Discord messages.

## Commands
- `/bridge setup` – starts setup (token → guild → channel).
- `/bridge token set <token>` – set your token without chat.
- `/bridge token clear` – clear saved token.
- `/bridge reset` – clears saved config and stops the bridge.
- `/bridge say <message>` – send a message to the selected Discord channel.
- `/bridge reply <message>` – reply to the last Discord DM you received.
- `/bridge status` – shows current status and toggles.
- `/bridge autoconnect on|off` – auto-join last channel on launch.
- `/bridge mute mc2dc on|off` – toggle Minecraft → Discord.
- `/bridge mute dc2mc on|off` – toggle Discord → Minecraft.
- `/bridge guild <id>` – switch server and list channels.
- `/bridge channel <id>` – switch channel immediately.
- `/bridge format guild <id> <prefix>` – set a guild prefix (supports `{guild}` `{channel}`).
- `/bridge format channel <id> <prefix>` – set a channel prefix (supports `{guild}` `{channel}`).
- `/bridge format clear guild <id>` – clear a guild prefix.
- `/bridge format clear channel <id>` – clear a channel prefix.
- `/bridge dm <user> <message>` – send a Discord DM by username or ID (tab-complete from friends/DMs).
- `/bridge dmlisten <user>` – prioritize receiving DMs from that user.
- `/bridge dmrefresh` – refresh DM autocomplete list.
- `/bridge help` – show command summary.

### Notes
- Tokens and settings are saved to `config/discordbridge.json`.
- Normal chat is not sent to Discord; use `/bridge say`.
- Incoming Discord DMs show in Minecraft with the sender's user ID.
- Client-side only: works on any multiplayer server.
- DM receiving polls a small set of recent DM channels to avoid rate limits.
